one_month_reasoning: ALAB's Q3 2026 report is not yet scheduled and most likely lands Nov 3-5, just after the 2026-10-29 window, so no company print is inside it. In-window events: (1) hyperscaler Q3 prints with 2027 capex commentary in the last week of October, two-sided and the main read-through for AI connectivity demand; (2) the Oct 28 FOMC, where markets price roughly 70% odds of a 25bp hike after hot inflation data (CNBC 2026-09-23, Kalshi), a headwind for a ~55x-P/E name, mostly priced but with asymmetric risk to a hawkish surprise; (3) OpenAI's frontier-training pause, which on Sep 28 was reported as its second in three months, widened, with no restart date and federal agencies involved (Yahoo Finance). I drop my round-1 mild positive lean on the thin (~$8k) Polymarket resumption market, which is now stale. No hyperscaler has cut capex, so this is sentiment rather than estimates risk. Net: a near-symmetric lognormal centred slightly below spot (median ~$354) with ~26% monthly sigma (99% realized vol / 3.5, slightly trimmed).
